title: Flood, Cameroon, 17 October 2019 (FL20191017CMR)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Cameroon, 17 October 2019 (FL20191017CMR), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20191017CMR**  This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in Mayo-Danay and Logone-et-Chari Department, Far-North Region of Cameroon as observed from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 11 October 2019. Within the analysed extent of about 7,200  km2, a total about 1,500 km2 of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected waters extents, as of 11 October 2019 over Logone-et-Chari Department, Far-North Region of Cameroon](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-extents-as-of-11-october-2019-over-logone-et-chari-department-far-north-region-of-c)
- [Satellite detected waters extents, as of 16 October 2019 over MayoDanay and Logone-et-Chari Department, Far-North Region](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-extents-as-of-16-october-2019-over-mayodanay-and-logone-et-chari-department-far-nor)
